scope: Secondary diagnostic on exchange-eligible unseen task pairs, image-equal. These are not task-balanced classification effects.

all.scope: Descriptor exchange on the same image using fixed trained selectors and cached score vectors.
all.aggregation: Average repeated seeds and task-pair rows within image, then weight images equally. Bootstrap resamples images.
all.panel_scope: Exchange-eligible anchor-image panel; these accuracies are not balanced binary-task benchmark accuracies.
all.task_split_scope: Unseen combinations are primary and seen combinations secondary; their task collections differ, so their contrast alone is not a pure transfer effect.
all.quartile_boundary_rule: An exact boundary belongs to the higher-numbered stratum.
